selected.title: His Mother Canceled Our Wedding Venue
selected.hook: My boyfriend's mother canceled our wedding venue without telling either of us.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend's mother canceled our wedding venue without telling either of us.

We'd been engaged for seven months, and she had opinions about everything. The flowers were too expensive. My dress was too plain. The guest list somehow had too many people from my side.

I kept telling myself she was just excited.

Then our venue coordinator called and asked why we'd decided to release our date.

I thought she had the wrong couple.

She didn't.

Someone had called that morning, given our booking details, and said we were canceling because of a family emergency.

My fiance called his mother.

She denied it for maybe thirty seconds before saying she was trying to save us from making a mistake.

Apparently she'd decided our venue was embarrassing compared to his cousin's wedding, and she assumed we'd thank her once we found somewhere better.

Except our date was now gone. Another couple had already taken it.

My fiance was furious and told her she wasn't allowed to help with the wedding anymore.

She started crying and said I was turning her son against his family.

Now she's telling relatives I deliberately chose a cheap venue to embarrass her.

My fiance wants to book somewhere else and keep the same wedding date if possible.

But part of me keeps thinking: if she'll secretly cancel our venue, what happens after we're married?

Would you still marry into a family that thinks boundaries are optional?
selected.youtube_description:
She thought her future mother-in-law was just being overly involved in the wedding until the venue coordinator called with a cancellation she never made. What happened next turned wedding planning into a much bigger fight about trust, family, and boundaries. Would you still go through with the marriage?
